summary: Repository state, runner evidence, and Git diff agree: only moldea/moldea.yaml changed, correcting the stale name to mcp__support__lookup_order. Validation is valid with zero diagnostics, complete tool evidence, and passing TypeScript compilation. Inspection was read-only.

moldea/moldea.yaml now declares name: mcp__support__lookup_order. Approved Git status reports only moldea/moldea.yaml modified, and its diff contains exactly the one-line name correction. The current inspect result is valid and emits tool-registration runtimeName mcp__support__lookup_order; the deterministic post-actor summary also reports valid validation and inspection.

Current manifest bindings remain supportAgent and loadSupportInstruction in src/agent.ts, lookupOrderTool in src/tools.ts, lookupOrder in src/implementations.ts, and LookupOrderInputSchema in src/contracts.ts. Current inspect emits all six evidence records, including instruction-loader, schema, and tool-registration references, with zero diagnostics. Runner assertions show these source files unchanged, and both deterministic and independently rerun TypeScript checks pass.
